title: Choices have different cancellation semantics
observed: Agent saves immediately; model and mode wait for Apply. Closing can retain only the agent change.
impact: Users cannot predict whether dismissal preserves their prior configuration.
proposal: Draft all choices; Apply sequentially with explicit partial-save recovery.
